scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera and composition: the paved terrace before the colonnade of a round marble parliament hall, Hellenistic Greece, real fluted marble columns, an open doorway in the drum behind. Replace every placeholder shape with real stone. Bright morning sun. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its three men, two goats and ledger exactly. In the foreground the plump merchant in the saffron tunic asks a question of the tall white-haired legislator in the purple-bordered himation, who frowns at his open ledger, a finger on its last entry. A few steps behind them the young goatherd with his crook waits, holding the two black goats on a rope. In the background other legislators in the same white and purple pass into the hall. Life-size figures fill the lower half of the frame. Deep focus. No text, nothing modern.
